errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given ID or name is not found in the database.

errors.name: ExpenseNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an expense with the given ID is not found in the database.

errors.name: BudgetExceededException
errors.description: Raised when an expense exceeds the budget limit for its category and month.

errors.name: InvalidBudgetMonthError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid month format (not 'YYYY-MM') is provided for budget operations.

errors.name: InvalidDateFormatError
errors.description: Raised when an expense date is not in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

errors.name: InvalidPaymentMethodError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid payment method ('cash', 'card', or 'transfer') is provided.

errors.name: InvalidRecurringFlagError
errors.description: Raised when the 'recurring' flag is not a boolean value.

errors.name: MissingCategoryError
errors.description: Raised when a category lookup fails due to missing category_id in the expense.

errors.name: MissingBudgetError
errors.description: Raised when a budget lookup fails due to missing category_id or month.

errors.name: InvalidBudgetAmountError
errors.description: Raised when the budget amount is not a positive integer.
